TRACE_ASSERTIONS.ASSERTION: MCP runtime preload converts lock and GraphRAG build failures into warnings instead of panics.
syn mcp stdout contains only JSON-RPC responses while tracing logs are emitted on stderr.
syn mcp public help remains stdio-only and does not expose HTTP or LSP flags before those transports are implemented.
MCP stdio reads JSON-RPC messages with a bounded line reader and returns a JSON-RPC error for oversized messages.
SynapseHandler stores and can invalidate GraphRAG cache keys for root/index-aware graph rebuilds.
JSON-RPC notifications do not produce response objects.
McpServer::start_stdio routes through the bounded MCP pipeline while SynapseHandler uses atomic initialization state for concurrent request handling.
McpServer::start_stdio applies observability pipeline queue, concurrency, and message-size bounds from Config.
Pipelined stdio requests preserve JSON-RPC response IDs and keep stdout response serialization single-writer.
tools/call records best-effort MCP active request and completed call metrics without changing JSON-RPC responses when tracking fails.
JSON-RPC tool dispatch routes analyze_logs to the GRACE structured LOG analyzer.
JSON-RPC tool dispatch routes extract_belief_state to the GRACE belief-state artifact writer.
JSON-RPC tool dispatch routes generate_requirements to the GRACE RequirementsAnalysis writer.
JSON-RPC tool dispatch routes generate_technology to the GRACE Technology writer.
JSON-RPC tool dispatch routes generate_development_plan to the GRACE DevelopmentPlan writer.
JSON-RPC tool dispatch routes mental_test_run to the GRACE MentalTest runner.
JSON-RPC tool dispatch routes traceability_report to the GRACE Traceability reporter.
JSON-RPC tool dispatch routes cascade_impact and cascade_execute to the GRACE cascade update engine.
JSON-RPC tool dispatch routes run_test_guide and submit_test_report to the GRACE agent-based testing workflow.
JSON-RPC tool dispatch routes advance_phase and pre_commit_check to bounded run gate handlers.
JSON-RPC tool dispatch routes lsp_hover and lsp_references through runtime Config so configured LSP server commands are honored.
Cacheable tools emit _meta.cache and store short-lived ETag validators under deterministic keys.
Matching _if_none_match returns _not_modified before invoking expensive cacheable handlers.
graphrag_query overview emits _meta.cache metadata when GraphRAG state is already cached.
The in-memory ETag cache clears all entries when the next insert would exceed 100 validators.
tools/call routes tools/recommend and returns bounded run-state-aware recommendations.
tools/call routes compact_evidence through run tools and returns persisted evidence compaction reports.
tools/call routes check_budget through budget tools and reports current session budget state.
tools/call routes context_pressure through budget tools and reports current context pressure state.
tools/call responses include _context_pressure at critical pressure and _auto_recommendation above 90 percent pressure.
tools/list uses pressure-aware style selection so high and critical pressure force terse schemas.
tools/list merges profile-visible user-defined tools with _source=user metadata and warning metadata.
tools/call routes unknown names to validated user-defined tools after built-in dispatch misses.
tools/list and tools/call create bounded telemetry spans without recording raw arguments.
Session budget gates block expensive tools with budget_exhausted=true, attach warning metadata near the limit, and allow light tools such as project_status and verify_project.
